title: Sard property for rank 2 polarizations in metabelian Lie groups
summary: We provide sharp bounds on the dimension of the abnormal set for rank $2$ polarizations on metabelian Lie groups, establishing the Sard property for the end-point map of such groups. The proof is based on a novel approach that makes essential use of tools from tame geometry. We also obtain bounds for the dimension of the Goh-abnormal set for metabelian Lie groups where the codimension of the derived subgroup is at most $2$, with no assumption on the rank of the polarization.
